tbesh_html:
1) rampart, fortress, wall
1a) rampart
1b) fortress
Also means: che.lah (חֵילָה "bulwark" H2430)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: an army; also (by analogy,) an intrenchment
strongs_1890.derivation: or (shortened) חֵל; a collateral form of H2428 (חַיִל);
strongs_1890.kjv_def: army, bulwark, host, [phrase] poor, rampart, trench, wall.
